items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: They had them on the boat once when Lizzie Miles and Paul Barberin played about four years ago.

ctx.x: Well, I'll tell you what happened uh, sometime uh, later than what I'm speaking of now. I was a drummer in John Tonkin Band in Alexander, Louisiana. And we used to go play at a place, I would say about three miles from Natchitoches, you call down on Cain River. And after intermission of the dance, each night we would play out there. We had to play a quadrille dance. Play a quadrille music that is for the older people to do that particular dance. And we used to play bye bye Blackbird. But we played in a swing or…

her side and call the figures. I saw on the boat they had some of the uh, same dancers. I forget the lady that the Madame Senegal or something. Name like I, she had a creole festival a few years ago. Five or six, oh maybe seven or eight years ago. On the boat you said? They had them on the boat once when Lizzie Miles and Paul Barberin played about four years ago.
